items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: And, you know, you had Jack Willis and all these.

ctx.x: Those were the guys you were listening to? Oh, yeah. On. And where were you hearing them? In the street?

I heard mostly. No, no, not in the street. I didn't hear them in the street. Uh-huh. The guys I heard in the street was Percy Humphrey, Kid Thomas. Yeah. And, uh, oh, let's see. I have to, I have to, I have to, I can't, some of these older trumpet players, I can't remember their names. Right, right. You know? But they're, you know, like, uh, Don, uh, Don Albert. Sure. We went to town and played a lot of time. And, uh, we call him Piggy. Uh, John Albert. John Albert was, uh, was his name. Barak. We called him…
